environment.description: Ktor microservice deployed on EKS cluster behind internal ALB (scheme: internal). The ALB resides in private subnets (10.2.64.0/19, 10.2.96.0/19). Security group sg-0a4f8e2c1b permits inbound TCP/443 exclusively from source security group sg-0d7c3a91ef (attached to the VPN gateway ENIs) and from CIDR 10.2.0.0/16 (VPC-local traffic only). Additionally, the VPC has no Internet Gateway attached and egress is routed through a NAT gateway with restrictive outbound rules. The Transit Gateway route table only propagates routes from the corporate DC attachment (AS 64512). DNS resolution for the ALB hostname is served only via Route53 private hosted zone associated with the VPC, making it unresolvable from public internet.

config.alb_security_group: sg-0a4f8e2c1b: ingress TCP/443 from sg-0d7c3a91ef (VPN GW ENIs) AND 10.2.0.0/16
config.nat_gateway_outbound: restricted to package repos and monitoring endpoints
config.network_policy: default-deny ingress, allow from namespace kube-system and monitoring only
